name: Voraxis
description:
About This Game

The Planet is Alive. Dig In.

VORAXIS is a turn-based roguelike deckbuilder where your cards are your only way to navigate. You are a cosmic parasite tunneling through a living, breathing world, desperately harvesting its pulsing resources before it recognizes you as a threat and consumes you.

In Voraxis, movement is the strategy. Every card played determines how you carve your path through a mutating grid.

Key Features

Your Deck is Your Drill: Forget traditional "attack" cards. In Voraxis, your deck controls your direction and your ability to clear the grid.

Evolve or Be Digested: The planet is mutating, and you must too. Customize your deck with Evolutions and Mutators that allow for wild run-to-run builds. Turn a simple "Move Left" card into a terrain-shattering explosion or a resource-vacuuming tool.

Death is Just a Nutrient: Failure is part of the cycle. Unlock new cards, build defining mutators, and powerful evolutions.

A Living, Pulsing World: You aren't just mining rocks; you’re tunneling through flesh, bone, and ancient cosmic matter. Time is of the essence!

Launch Content

  • 30+ Playing Cards

  • 60+ Mutators

  • 50+ Different Evolutions

  • 10+ Catalysts to come

Explore more of Voraxis in the full game!
short_desc: The planet is alive, and you are the parasite. VORAXIS is a roguelike deckbuilder where every card determines how you dig through a mutating, organic world. Carve through shifting tunnels, evolve your deck, and harvest the planet’s heart before it digests you.
